content.text: {"core": "Wisdom holds knowing quiet until it ripens, refusing to speak before the shape is whole. In Abstraction, it works on stepping back to see the pattern behind the particulars. Overdone, the stepping-back never stops — everything gets lifted into theory before it is lived, and the pattern swells until the actual things drop out of sight.", "sheetLine": "The seeing rose so high the things it came from vanished."}
